description: Fader and VCA in stereo, with a mute button

params.text: The level of both sides, -60dB to +6dB with unity at the 0 mark

inputs.text: A 0-10V CV over the level, attenuated by the fader
Anything above 0.5V here mutes, whatever the mute button is set to
The left signal in; with nothing patched to the right it feeds both sides

outputs.text: The left side after the fader and the mute
The right side after the fader and the mute

menu: Input 1 poly spread — spreads a polyphonic cable at input 1 across the two channels: None (normal polyphonic), Channels 1-2, Channels 3-4, and so on to Channels 15-16
